heading: Appointment and term of service of Librarian of Congress

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The President shall appoint the Librarian of Congress, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate.

tree.heading: Term of service
tree.text: The Librarian of Congress shall be appointed for a term of 10 years.

tree.heading: Reappointment
tree.text: An individual appointed to the position of Librarian of Congress, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate, may be reappointed to that position in accordance with subsections (a) and (b).

tree.heading: Effective date
tree.text: This section shall apply with respect to appointments made on or after November 5, 2015.
